records.source_to_target: GBA ROM/BIOS → native Windows/macOS/Linux/Android runtime or packaged executable. Android dependencies are documented in maintainer README; no assertion that an Android binary is published.
records.method: Ahead-of-time static recompilation: emits C11 linked to the Rust GBA hardware model; interpreter remains as a stability fallback. Function-boundary map is incomplete.
records.license: Project code dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0; GBA function-map database stated as CC0.
records.compatibility_evidence: README says 169,778 / estimated 4.1 million functions mapped and one complete game without naming it; only the current exact project statements are retained.

records.source_to_target: Game Boy / Game Boy Color ROM → SWF plus offline HTML/Ruffle playback. Releases shown for macOS and Windows; SWF runs in Ruffle-supported browsers.
records.method: Execution profiling plus static translation of observed basic blocks; unknown/ineligible blocks stay interpreted. Lockstep compares frames before output.
records.license: MIT for project code/runtime; bundled Ruffle and other dependencies retain their own licenses.
records.compatibility_evidence: README documents supported DMG/CGB hardware/features and explicit sound/timing/cartridge/peripheral limits; seven open-licensed homebrew titles reportedly tested.

records.source_to_target: PSP ISO/ELF/PRX → C++20 → native macOS/Windows Refract runtime; optional PSP PRX back-compilation is diagnostics/partial overlays.
records.method: Static lifting of Allegrex MIPS and VFPU to C++20; PSP output is not claimed as a performant full-game target.
records.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (README says GPL version 3 or later; repository API classifies GPL-3.0).
records.compatibility_evidence: README marks macOS and Windows host backends working; Linux planned; Daxter fully playable on macOS; PSP hardware/PPSSPP path diagnostic/overlay only.

records.source_to_target: Daxter PSP executable → C++20 → native macOS ARM64/x86_64.
records.method: Same psprism static recompilation and Refract runtime as the software record; game-specific README status says fully playable on macOS.
records.license: GPL-3.0-or-later for psprism/Refract code; does not license Daxter content.
records.compatibility_evidence: README labels Daxter fully playable on macOS; it does not establish Daxter support on Windows or full-speed execution on PSP.

records.source_to_target: Android ARMv7 libmain.so and game data → PlayStation Vita.
records.method: Loader relocates a user-provided Android ELF against Vita-side libc/SDL/GL wrappers and calls SDL_main; classify as Android/Vita API translation/binary loading, not a source-native port.
records.license: No license declared in repository metadata or README checked.
records.compatibility_evidence: Maintainer README claims about 36 FPS without overclocking; prerequisite list includes HENkaku/kubridge/libshacccg; known softlock: open keyboard while paused.

records.source_to_target: Oracle of Ages Game Boy Color ROM → native Windows/Linux/macOS player.
records.method: Current runtime interprets ROM; generated static C path is documented as removed; optional native Ages reconstruction is a hidden developer preview.
records.license: MIT declared by README and LICENSE file; GitHub repository API returns NOASSERTION, retained as an audit discrepancy.
records.compatibility_evidence: README identifies supported USA/Australia ROM SHA-1 hashes for Oracle of Ages and says both Oracles run from one binary.
